name: Monitoring and inspection
shared_components: Common data acquisition, calibration, event logs and inspection records
make_buy: Buy industrial sensors and DAQ; develop software and fixtures
validation: Measurement uncertainty, mounting repeatability, data quality, false alarms
decision: Do not put AI in the safety loop. Start advisory.

name: DIN interface drum brakes
applications: Factory cranes, industrial winches and material handling
shared_components: Base, levers, springs, shoes and adjustments across controlled size variants
make_buy: Design assembly; outsource metalwork; buy thruster and lining initially
validation: Holding/dynamic torque, release time, thermal duty, wear, fatigue
decision: Approve one real duty envelope before selecting the first sizes.

name: Spring-applied disc calipers
applications: Conveyors, winches, cranes and heavy industry
shared_components: Caliper architecture, lining retention, mounting and spring arrangements
make_buy: Design assembly; outsource bodies; buy hydraulic actuation parts
validation: Contact balance, torque, thermal growth, release clearance, seal/spring life
decision: Parallel requirements work; separate lead needed for parallel detailed design.

name: Service parts and friction kits
shared_components: Shoes, pads, bushes, pins, seals and adjustment kits tied to revisions
make_buy: Buy characterized lining compound; outsource controlled parts
validation: Friction-pair validation, retention, lot consistency and fit
decision: Start with our own assemblies; competitor compatibility requires separate assessment.

name: Drums, discs and hubs
shared_components: Machined rotating interfaces and documented material variants
validation: Thermal cycles, surface finish, runout, balance, speed and hub strength
decision: Keep each friction pair and rotor material configuration identifiable.

name: AISE/AIST interface shoe brakes
applications: Steel mills, ports and export replacement projects
shared_components: Reuse proven mechanisms where requirements permit; distinct interface families
make_buy: Design adaptations; outsource metalwork; buy actuation
validation: Imperial interfaces, severity of duty, endurance and machine qualification
decision: Not just a unit conversion from DIN.

name: Electrohydraulic thrusters
shared_components: Motor, pump, piston, seals and force/stroke variants
make_buy: Buy initially; evaluate proprietary design after performance and cost studies
validation: Force-stroke-time curves, temperature, orientation, leakage and endurance
decision: Treat as its own development programme, including electrical requirements.

name: Hydraulic power units
applications: Hydraulically released calipers and emergency brakes
shared_components: Reservoir, pump, valves, filtration, sensing and manifolds
make_buy: Integrate purchased qualified components before custom hydraulic development
validation: Release/application transients, contamination, leakage, loss of power and pressure
decision: Controlled braking requires system dynamics and machine interface requirements.

name: Flexible and gear couplings
shared_components: Shared hub interfaces and modular rotating components
make_buy: Buy proven couplings initially; design only against defined demand
validation: Misalignment, torsion, balance, fatigue and lubrication
decision: Keep coupling torque capacity distinct from braking torque.

name: Positive-actuated brakes
applications: Process machinery and controlled braking applications
shared_components: Reuse selected caliper or shoe elements with distinct actuation
make_buy: Buy actuator/control components; design mechanism variants
validation: Loss-of-actuation behaviour, modulation, timing and application integration
decision: Does not inherit spring-applied fail-safe behaviour.

name: Industrial buffers
applications: Cranes, travelling equipment and end stops
shared_components: Energy absorber families selected by actual impact requirements
make_buy: Initially partner with specialist energy-absorber suppliers
validation: Impact energy, peak force, stroke, recovery, temperature and repeated impacts
decision: Cannot qualify from brake torque tests.

name: Storm, locking and special systems
make_buy: Partner first; design against signed system requirements
validation: Wind/rail interface, static holding, fault states and system integration
decision: Hazardous-area and personnel-transport uses need distinct qualification projects.
